Great location, just a short drive from the expressway.
The place is clean and access to the building is controlled by key cards.
There's a food court downstairs with a wide selection of food at normal prices. Most of the customers are office workers.
Free parking for the first 2 hours.

The new building has cleaning staff, and the elevators have a floor-locking system, allowing access only to the intended floor. There are about 10 restaurants, a 7-Eleven, an Amazon cafe, a gym, and a buffet restaurant. The building is decorated for holidays; for example, Christmas has a Christmas tree and Santa Claus handing out candy. However, the motorcycle parking needs improvement as it's insufficient and the back entrance is locked, forcing riders to walk around to the front, exposed to sun and rain. Those carrying documents must be careful not to get wet as there's no shelter. Running requires caution due to the slippery, smooth surface. Motorcycles are double-parked, and some security guards refuse to move them. The car parking lot has about 11 floors with two-way access. After 8:30 AM, parking is usually only available on the 5th or 6th floor. Tenants should be aware of air conditioning issues; the air conditioning ducts near the windows may not reach all areas, and turning the AC centrally can make it too cold.
It's convenient to contact me for work. There are restaurants on the ground floor.

The building's service is very bad. They don't work systematically. Parking is very bad. If you lose your card, you can't exit. There's no way to fix it. You have to find the card first before exiting. The car has been parked in the building for many days. Finally, they charge by the hour. What the hell? I lost thousands of baht in parking fees. It's really terrible.

We drove around looking for parking, went up to the building, and finally found a spot. We walked to the information desk and asked for the company we were bringing the claim to. The guard told us the building was an office, so we should claim at Rat Burana.
We thought, "Okay, that's a waste of time. I didn't call to check properly."
So we asked where we could get our parking ticket stamped. The guard said it would be free within 15 minutes. Wow, it took 15 minutes to find a parking spot."
So we hurried back to the car and drove out.
It turned out we walked for 1 minute, parked for 16 minutes, and paid 40 baht for parking.
We wanted to get our ticket stamped, but we thought we'd have to drive back up to find another spot. It would take longer, take more time, and make things even worse.
We paid, it hurt, and that was the end of our lesson.

For exiting, insert your visitor card to open the doors and walk out.

If you are here to submit additional documents to the Revenue Department, please go to the 4th floor.
